title: Jacket or Pants Rental for Snowbasin and Powder Mountain
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must choose this item twice if renting jacket and pants.
The largest and smallest sizes are limited. It's recommended to call the day ahead to the shop where you are renting to make sure they will have it in stock for you.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Keep warm and dry while on the slopes with our rental parka or pants. Must choose this item twice if renting both. Whether you rent the rest of your equipment from us or have your own, it's important to protect your skin by wearing the right kind of weather resistant clothing. Rental period is 24 hours.
